text: Currency overflow PR (#6037) in progress (stacked after #6751, the Currency numeric functions PR): any Currency result outside +-922337203685477.5807 is error 1988 instead of a silent Number, and Currency division by zero is also 1988 (probed; not the Numeric div-by-zero error). CEILING at the very top of the range raises 1988 where VFP9 silently wraps to a wrong value (deliberate improvement, labelled in the test and the row). Also filed per the owner: #6743 big numeric types and #6744 optional native table format (both agent-approved, design first, decisions recorded in the issues), and #6745-#6750 opt-in strict typing / interfaces / abstraction for PRG (tracking #6750).
